description: This file contains Swift extension methods for the ChannelsSettings class, providing UI components built with SwiftUI for managing channel settings such as WhatsApp and Telegram, including login, logout, refresh, and configuration sections.

methods.name: formSection
methods.description: Creates a form section with a title and content view, styled with a GroupBox and VStack.

methods.name: channelHeaderActions
methods.description: Provides UI buttons for logging out from WhatsApp and Telegram channels, and a refresh button.

methods.name: whatsAppSection
methods.description: UI section for managing WhatsApp linking, including displaying login messages, QR code, and related actions.

methods.name: genericChannelSection
methods.description: Creates a configuration section for a given channel, using its channel ID.

methods.name: configEditorSection
methods.description: Provides UI for editing, saving, and reloading channel configuration.

methods.name: configStatusMessage
methods.description: Displays the current configuration status message, if available.
